definitions.explanation: a person whose job is to sell products or services

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}マンとして{働|はたら}いている。
{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{営業|えいぎょう}マンは{顧客|こきゃく}との{信頼関係|しんらいかんけい}を{大切|たいせつ}にする。
examples.english: Excellent salespeople value their relationships with customers.

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}マンが{商品|しょうひん}の{説明|せつめい}に{来|き}た。
examples.english: A salesperson came to explain the product.

notes:
GENDER-NEUTRAL ALTERNATIVES:
- {営業|えいぎょう}{担当|たんとう} - sales representative (gender-neutral)
- {営業|えいぎょう}{担当者|たんとうしゃ} - sales representative (formal, gender-neutral)
- セールスパーソン - salesperson (gender-neutral loanword)

RELATED TERMS:
- {営業|えいぎょう}{部|ぶ} - sales department
- {営業|えいぎょう}{活動|かつどう} - sales activities
- {飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう} - cold calling
- ルート{営業|えいぎょう} - route sales (visiting existing clients)

NOTE ON ~マン:
Words ending in マン (from English "man") are gradually being replaced with gender-neutral alternatives in modern Japanese business language.
